extraction.aggregation: float64 sum of all equally weighted frames, divided once and cast float32; noninstruction slots zero
extraction.source_demonstrations: First 20 prescribed standard training demonstrations per donor; all recorded frames receive equal weight
extraction.timing_note: Per-donor extraction process wall time is recorded independently; summed concurrent work is not workflow elapsed time. All donors report zero resumed frames.

scope: Training demonstration text-latent extraction only; no rollout performance evaluation

verification.method: Read-only load_bank validation of saved NPZ tensors and frame ledgers, inventory/manifest/runtime reconciliation, and test/completion-log checks. Model hidden states are not recomputed.
